title: Upgrading from Godot 3 to Godot 4
key_points: Godot 4.0 has many new features and bug fixes compared to Godot 3.x
Upgrading gives access to a longer support period for 4.x versions
Some features were lost in the upgrade process, but may be restored later
limitations: Godot 4's baseline hardware requirements are slightly higher than those of Godot 3
Godot 4 binary sizes are larger than those of Godot 3 for exported projects
Godot 4 does not support GLES2 rendering, which may prevent running on very old hardware
asserts: Upgrading from Godot 3 to Godot 4 provides access to new features, bug fixes, and a longer support period.
scope: The source asserts the advantages and disadvantages of upgrading a Godot project from version 3 to version 4, including new features, bug fixes, hardware requirements changes, binary size differences, and lack of GLES2 rendering support in Godot 4.
